messages:
Julia K.: Quick sync — sprinting the keyword catalog this week. We need a short list of redirects + schema priorities to lock before the webinar landing goes live.
Mike T.: +1. Can we keep redirects to 1:1 where possible? avoids weird chains.
Sara L.: Agree. Also need canonical decisions for the resource hub vs the webinar page. If the webinar is primary, hub should link via rel=canonical? or the other way around?
Lee R.: My vote: webinar page gets canonical for the event URL, hub stays evergreen and links to the page with strong internal anchor text. Hub shouldn't steal SERP.
Dan P.: For redirects, are we doing path-based rules or a small explicit map? I worry rules will catch unrelated paths.
Mike T.: explicit map for the launch week. Example mapping I'm proposing:
```
/old-webinar-signup -> /webinars/2026/fast-inference
/blog/kv-cache-guide -> /learn/kv-cache-best-practices
/launch-notes -> /resources/release-2026-05
```
Keep it tiny and audited.
Sara L.: Love that. Also: schema types — Event schema for the webinar (Event + offers for registration), FAQ schema on the landing, and breadcrumb schema on hub pages.
Julia K.: Tagging priorities for content ops: 1) redirects map, 2) event schema + startDate/organizer, 3) FAQ Qs pulled from last webinar transcript, 4) internal anchor plan from hub -> webinar.
seo-bot: Reminder: run prerender check after applying schema. Report: missing requiredEventFields -> startDate.
Dan P.: Noted — I'll put the start/end times in UTC and the organizer as "Redwood Inference". Will also add ticketOffer with availability.
Lee R.: Internal linking: use target anchor text: "Redwood Inference webinar: High-performance LLM inference" from hub pages. Avoid exact-match spammy kw on more than 3 pages.
Mike T.: Small A/B on canonical: variant A (hub canonical) vs variant B (webinar canonical) — we can measure impressions over 72h. But let's not roll that in the first 24h.
Sara L.: Can someone draft the FAQ Qs? I'll assemble and send to design for accordion markup.
Julia K.: @Sara L. you're owner for FAQ. @Dan P. you're owner for redirects map and schema fields. @Mike T. you'll monitor search impressions + URL inspection. I'll own rollout timing and publish checklist.
Mike T.: I'll set up a GA event and a Search Console inspection batch.
Dan P.: Putting the redirect map in the repo under seo/redirects_2026-05.csv and I'll request deploy Friday morning.
Sara L.: Drafted 6 FAQs, will drop in the doc by EOD. Also adding 2 long-tail keywords we should seed in the hub: "inference economics" and "LLM serving latency best practices".
Julia K.: Perfect. Final checklist before deploy: redirects file + test, schema validated, FAQ markup implemented, internal links added, canonical decisions logged. If all green, publish 10:00 PT on Monday.
Mike T.: :rocket: Sounds good. I'll monitor the first-hour crawl errors.
Julia K.: Thanks all — we'll circle up after the deploy.
